primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with ≥1-stage improvement in liver fibrosis on the NASH CRN histological scoring system at Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: Fibrosis improvement: 15.4% with CC-90001 100 mg, 0% with 200 mg, 7.7% with 400 mg, and 6.7% with placebo. No statistical comparison was reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 2/13 participants on 100 mg, 1/15 on 200 mg, 2/13 on 400 mg, and 0/15 on placebo; no deaths were reported.
